title: Good gift, not as valueable as they would have you believe
text: I signed up for the June 2020 cat lady box.  Their customer service is excellent, as I had foolishly ordered without selecting a size option.  They replied quickly and answered all of my questions.  Kudos for being responsive and helpful.  The cats loved the box.  As soon as I opened it, one was inside ripping apart the tissue paper trying to get at the catnip toys.  I guess the whole box smells like catnip because she came back for more when there was not any.  A plastic bag holding socks ended up on the floor and rolled around on too.  My box's value comes to $56.95.  They are kind enough to include a card listing each item and that items retail value.  I now have a cat head shaped bath mat ($17.99), cat light charging cord ($13.99), 3 pairs of cat paw socks ($14.99), and two catnip toys each valued at ($4.99).  The socks seem better suited for fall vs. summer, the rug is white and will probably end up a cat bed or in one, the charger has purple plastic cat faces all over it and looks more like those lights you hang up around your patio/porch in summer.  In truth, I have paid $25 for a differently themed subscription box and received items with a total value over $200.  So I guess I just expected better from a $35 box.  It would make a cute gift but I will not be looking to keep this as a month to month subscription.
label: neutral
